def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # border color: most common

    c=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    border=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find frame border rows: rows entirely border (in left region) -- simpler: full rows of border across whole width? use rows where all of left region is border

    # find contiguous sep columns near middle

    j=0
    while j<W and not all(grid[i][j]==0 for i in range(H)): j+=1
    left_w=j
    brow=[i for i in range(H) if all(grid[i][jj]==border for jj in range(left_w))]
    frames=[]
    prev=None
    for i in brow:
        if prev is not None and i-prev>1: frames.append((prev+1,i-1))
        prev=i
    # shapes: right region, per row-group? find connected components of nonzero non-border in right region
    right0=left_w
    # skip sep columns
    while right0<W and all(grid[i][right0]==0 for i in range(H)): right0+=1
    seen=set(); shapes=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for jj in range(right0,W):
            if grid[i][jj]!=0 and (i,jj) not in seen:
                color=grid[i][jj]; stack=[(i,jj)]; comp=[]
                seen.add((i,jj))
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and right0<=nx<W and grid[ny][nx]!=0 and (ny,nx) not in seen:

                ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)

        ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
